video_title: Anthony Edwards Took The Timberwolves To Paris

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on his travel experience to Paris with the team
quotes.excerpt: I've been flying around for 26 hours, but finally going to jump across the ocean.
quotes.quote: I'm heading to Paris, France. I'm in the airport in Atlanta right now. I was flying in from LAX and had a connecting flight through Minnesota to get with all the guys. Unfortunately, Minnesota had some type of crazy outage or something, so I missed that flight with the team. I've been flying around for 26 hours, but finally going to jump across the ocean. I'm going to go ahead and see you guys when I'm in the hotel in Paris, France.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the team's practice facility in Paris
quotes.excerpt: We just ran some threes and fours, full court, and stuff.
quotes.quote: I just got done hooping. They are over here in the gym. It's a nice little setup. We just ran some threes and fours, full court, and stuff. I'm going to go ahead and go to the Eiffel Tower, do some shopping, and kick it with some of the team. I'm going to bring you guys along, show you what we're eating, and everything. It's been dope.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Clark on the team's attention to detail in Paris
quotes.excerpt: I just thought that little attention to detail is super dope.
quotes.quote: They put our numbers and stuff. My thing says number seven. It says JC. They even drew a little Timberwolves on the shower. I just thought that little attention to detail is super dope. It's been a great trip so far. I'm going to break this up into a few episodes, so it's not just going to be one dumb long video.
